laws.name: CMS Interoperability and Patient Access final rule (CMS-9115-F)
laws.requires: Patient Access API (member-authenticated, includes MA-PD formulary and Medicaid PDL data) and public Provider Directory API.
laws.appliesTo: MA orgs, Medicaid/CHIP FFS and managed care, FFE QHP issuers (Provider Directory API exempts QHPs)

laws.name: Medicaid Patient Access API: preferred drug list information
laws.requires: State makes PDL information available through API within one business day of effective date.

laws.name: CMS Interoperability and Prior Authorization final rule (CMS-0057-F)
laws.requires: 72h/7-day PA decisions, denial reasons, public PA metrics, Prior Authorization/Provider Access/Payer-to-Payer APIs.
laws.appliesTo: MA, Medicaid/CHIP FFS and managed care, FFE QHP issuers (QHPs exempt from decision times)

laws.name: CMS Interoperability Standards and Prior Authorization for Drugs proposed rule (CMS-0062-P)
laws.requires: PROPOSED: 24h drug PA decisions (Medicaid/CHIP), 72h/24h for QHPs; NCPDP SCRIPT, Formulary & Benefit, RTPB; drug PA in APIs.
laws.appliesTo: Medicaid/CHIP, FFE QHPs, MA (per fact sheet)
laws.effective: Proposed compliance 2027-10-01; no final rule found

laws.name: QHP prescription drug benefit and formulary publication
laws.requires: Public up-to-date formulary list with tiers and restrictions; FFE QHPs post in HHS-specified format (JSON) and submit to HHS; exception timelines 72h/24h.
laws.effective: Ongoing; JSON monthly update per CMS MR-PUF guidance

laws.name: CMS machine-readable QHP provider/formulary guidance
laws.requires: index.json, plans.json, drugs.json, providers.json posted publicly over HTTPS.

laws.name: Part D plan disclosure and formulary website requirements
laws.requires: Current formulary on website updated at least monthly; negative-change notice; real-time tool with alternatives and UM status.

laws.name: Medicaid managed care formulary information
laws.requires: Disclose covered drugs and tiers; post drug list as a machine-readable file in a format specified by the Secretary (none found).

laws.name: Medicaid drug rebate program: PA, P&T, DUR
laws.requires: PA programs respond within 24 hours and allow 72-hour emergency supply ((d)(5), per state agency sources; statute text unread); formulary/P&T conditions in (d)(4) (unconfirmed).

laws.name: Transparency in Coverage machine-readable files
laws.requires: In-network and allowed-amount MRFs; prescription drug MRF required but not implemented.

laws.name: State step therapy reform laws
laws.citation: 38 states + DC per ABA (2026); e.g. Illinois ban eff. 2026-01-01
laws.requires: Exception pathways for step therapy; Illinois bans it in fully insured plans.
laws.appliesTo: Fully insured state-regulated plans (not ERISA self-funded)

laws.name: State PA exemption (gold-carding)
laws.requires: Exempt physicians with high PA approval rates from PA for a service.
laws.appliesTo: State-regulated commercial plans in TX (similar laws elsewhere, unconfirmed)

laws.name: State formulary change notice laws
laws.citation: 215 ILCS 134/25 (IL); Maine PL ch. 429; Minn. Stat. 62Q.83; KY 806 KAR (excerpts only)
laws.requires: 30-60 days' notice before removing a drug mid-year.

laws.name: State electronic PA / NCPDP SCRIPT mandates
laws.citation: Md. (2026-07-01 deadline); Minn. Stat. 62J.497; W.Va. 2023; Alaska 2025
laws.requires: Payers accept ePA for drugs using NCPDP SCRIPT.

laws.name: Feist v. Rural Telephone (compilation copyright)
laws.requires: Facts are not copyrightable; compilations protected only for original selection/arrangement. No formulary-specific case found.
